text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ouch!! Huh, what is this, an injury?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah... The sweat's really irritating my 
skin. My breakouts are getting hard to 
ignore at this point—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...No. Wait, no, no, no!? Isn't this 
actually a good sign in its own right!?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It just means your body sent an SOS before 
you completely collapsed!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Still... I just can't help but wonder~!!
